summary: Completed comprehensive testing of enhanced AM AI SAFE web application with all 4 major improvements successfully implemented and working. Backend 100% functional with fixed predefined answer system. Frontend fully operational with all enhanced features properly displayed and functional.

resolved_issues.issue: Backend answer system was using enum values (NON_IDEAL, BASIC, GOOD, IDEAL, OTHER) instead of accepting predefined answers from spreadsheet
resolved_issues.fix_applied: Updated AnswerSubmit model to accept string instead of enum, implemented calculate_answer_score function to score predefined answers based on position

passed_tests: Backend: All 11 domains properly structured and accessible
Backend: All 88 questions with proper domain codes (FA-1 to FA-8, TR-1 to TR-8, etc.)
Backend: Complete explanations from spreadsheet implemented as help_text for all questions
Backend: Predefined answers from spreadsheet stored and accessible (FA-1 has 8 predefined options)
Backend: Fixed answer submission system to accept predefined answer text instead of enums
Backend: Domain-by-domain question progression with proper ordering
Backend: Status endpoint returns proper domain-grouped data with completion indicators
Backend: Answer scoring system based on predefined answer position
Backend: Assessment creation and progress tracking with 88-question system
Frontend: Landing page correctly displays enhanced system info (11 domains, 88 questions)
Frontend: Authentication and user signup working correctly
Frontend: Assessment page loads with all enhanced features
Frontend: Domain-by-domain progression visible in sidebar with current domain highlighting
Frontend: Help text/context displayed from spreadsheet explanations
Frontend: Predefined answer options displayed correctly (8 options for FA-1)
Frontend: Answer selection and saving working with predefined answers
Frontend: Status view modal shows all 11 domains with 8 questions each
Frontend: Question navigation and grid view functional
Frontend: Progress tracking shows correct counts (1 of 88 answered, 1% complete)
Integration: Frontend-backend integration working seamlessly with enhanced features
Integration: Answer submission with predefined answers working end-to-end
action_item_for_E1: All 4 major enhancements successfully implemented and tested. No critical issues found. The application now fully supports: 1) Domain-by-domain question progression, 2) Complete explanations from spreadsheet as context, 3) Pre-defined answer options from spreadsheet, 4) Simplified status view with domain grouping. Ready for production use.
